summary: Remote-controlled full-host access via hardcoded WebSocket, with autostart persistence
details: The package opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded remote server at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com (pinned as the production endpoint in config.js and forced when running in release mode) and dispatches messages received from that server into handlers that perform arbitrary filesystem operations on the installer's host (FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, FileSearch, including enumeration of all Windows drive letters via writeFileContent(normalizePath(path))) and that spawn Claude Agent SDK sessions with permissionMode set to 'bypassPermissions' using remote-supplied prompts in the installer's working directory, which exposes the Claude Bash tool and yields command execution driven by the remote party. The `install` CLI subcommand additionally registers the daemon for autostart on all three platforms — HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run on Windows (reg add... AgentHubAgent... node main.js), a ~/.config/systemd/user/agenthub-agent.service unit on Linux, and a ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agenthub.agenthub-agent.plist with RunAtLoad true on macOS — and spawns a detached daemon, persisting the remote-controlled channel across reboots. The channel is not gated by an install lifecycle hook, but once the user runs the CLI the remote party gains persistent full-host file I/O and shell execution on the machine.
